subject: Lane B SOURCE DEFECT: Beta2 admits stale wake generations + recovered opening races cover return against INNER wake
body: Exact field-APK source evidence from GitHub Actions run 37091317521. Beta2 changes Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.wakeInner from strict generation fencing to `if (!controller.isGenerationCurrent(generation) && !openingState) return`, and removes the baseline coroutine-time `if (!controller.isGenerationCurrent(generation)) return@launch` immediately before ShizukuBridge.wakeInnerDisplay(). Therefore any stale request generation is allowed to execute whenever the CURRENT controller state is OPENING_FROM_CLOSED or INNER_HANDOFF. This is a confirmed source defect independent of whether it caused the field crash; retries already call wakeInner(controller.generation), so stale-generation admission is not required for retry function. A second source-confirmed race is specific to recovered first opens: Beta2 onEarlyOpeningEdge admits COVER_PREWARMING/COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL and appends ReleaseSecondary before WakeInner; apply() launches releaseCoverLease and wakeInner as independent IO work, then FoldOverlayService starts gen3Visual opening after onEarlyOpeningEdge returns. Shell COVER_PANEL_GEN4 is serialized through runCoverMutation, but WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY is handled outside that queue. normalizeGen4SecondaryRoute can disable the cover secondary logical route once inner is default while wakeInner concurrently enables/powers the 1968x2184 route. Thus route return, inner wake, topology callbacks and cover-host visual startup can overlap on the recovered first attempt; a clean NATIVE_COVER later opening skips ReleaseSecondary. This gives a much stronger first-only causal model than invalid-display screenshot failure. Deterministic tests: stale-wake fence model PASS 5/5; exact APPLIED-SOURCE.diff marker assertions PASS 7/7. No production write. Proposed Manager/Primary review direction: restore strict immutable generation/attempt fencing at wake entry AND immediately before shell call; do not substitute a newer generation into an older retry series; retain outgoing cover visual host until same-attempt INNER useful-presentation proof before route retirement. Physical causal proof still requires a first-fail trace.
